item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las bzlog pa rang gshed rang la dbab pa
item.coloph: khro bo gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi bzlog (zlog) pa/ dbal chen stag la me 'bar gyi (gyis) mdzad srol/ lha klu mi gsum gyi gtan la phabs (phab) nas/ nam mkha' snang ba'i mdog can la brgyud pa'o/ des bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' la brgyad pa'o/ des sdang (stang) dmu tsa (tsha) gyer med la brgyad cing / ye shes dbal mo la gnyer du gtad do/ dus nam zhig nas phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen la brgyud nas 'phel ba'i rgyu lags so// khro bo gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi bzlog pa/ dbal chen po stag la me 'bar gyis mdzad srol/ lha klu mi gsum gyi gtan la phab nas/ nam mkha' snang ba'i mdog can la brgyud pa'o/ des bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud pa'o/ des sdang dmu tsha gyer med la brgyud cing / ye shes dbal mo la gnyer du gtad do/ dus nam zhig nas phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen la brgyud nas 'phel ba'i rgyu lags so//
